consumesExternalOutput.provenance: rule (f) binds this witness because its third member touches plugin/src/pr-main.ts, which spawns gh and reads its exit status. The refusal arm never reaches gh, so the external program whose output this behaviour's assertions consume is the child itself: the test spawns `node plugin/src/pr-main.ts` and reads its two streams and its exit code. The cited capture is a real run of both subcommands with every credential name removed from the environment, taken 2026-09-18 on node v26.6.0 from the repository root, recording each stream as a JSON string literal so nothing is normalised away. test/next.test.ts parses it and requires the live run to reproduce it byte for byte, which is what stops the one-line and nonzero-exit assertions from being strings chosen to match the implementation (CLAUDE.md standing warning 10). What this does NOT cover: gh's own output is not captured anywhere, because gh is absent from this container and the credential-present arm is therefore unexercised here.
